sloka: सीता हि राजवचनादाश्रमं पुण्यकर्मणाम् ।मया नेया महर्षीणां श्रीघ्रमानीयतां रथः ।। ७.४६.३ ॥
transliteration: sītā hi rājavacanādāśramaṁ puṇyakarmaṇām ।mayā neyā maharṣīṇāṁ śrīghramānīyatāṁ rathaḥ ।। 7.46.3 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, Sita is to be taken by me to the hermitage of the virtuous great sages by the king's command, so let the chariot be brought quickly.
